region_scene_page.standard: Celia Cruz, Fania-era salsa, and later bachata/tropical crossover show a dance tradition that can be local, diasporic, and pop-facing at once. region_scene_page.deep: Celia Cruz, Fania-era salsa, and later bachata/tropical crossover show a dance tradition that can be local, diasporic, and pop-facing at once.
